traitUnlock.name: Trait unlock
traitUnlock.description: Opens one Friend Studio trait for this Friend. The studio records which trait it opened and its edition number.

unlockTrait.label: Unlock traits
unlockTrait.description: 1,000 RF of credit per unit (the first release's purchase). Credit opens traits at their prices.

buy.label: Unlock traits
buy.description: Pays for the traits you picked, at each trait's own price, in one payment.
